purpose: Wave-5 Havenhythe thin-coverage fix for regional-skilling-unlocks.json. CRITICAL: emit first-class havenhythe:empowered-summoning-obelisks and havenhythe:jackalope-familiar so shrine hub outbound refs stop gaslighting planners. Plus other high-value Havenhythe permanent skilling unlocks still missing (jackalope hunting tertiary, Spirit Wolves shop / Blessings of the Wolf, Fang of Mohegan, Apex Hide → Masterwork Ranged craft path, giant crayfish, Wendlewick lodestone + teleport, Altar of Inanna, Eastfold Farm, Trader Woes bank). Wiki-backed only; no re-emit of the 16 present primary ids.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region_hint.
policy.duplicate_guard: SKIP already first-class: havenhythe:amberfell-hub, havenhythe:big-game-hunter, havenhythe:birdhouses, havenhythe:canoe-network, havenhythe:creeping-ivy, havenhythe:eternal-magic-nursery, havenhythe:highweald-mining, havenhythe:marigold-farm-patches, havenhythe:moonrise-dig-site, havenhythe:ring-of-kayazu, havenhythe:shaman-outfit, havenhythe:shrine-of-inanna-summoning-hub, havenhythe:spirit-moths, havenhythe:tear-of-inanna-hungry-like-the-wolf, havenhythe:volatile-chinchompas, havenhythe:wendlewick-fish-farm, havenhythe:no-area-tasks-diary, havenhythe:no-tear-of-the-mists.
policy.broken_ref_fix: Emit empowered-summoning-obelisks + jackalope-familiar as real rows (wiki-confirmed). Do not rewrite shrine hub notes to drop those ids — the ids are real product unlocks that never landed in regional-skilling.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent account unlocks, region-gated production hubs, and self-supply craft paths.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour as planner truths. Unlock state, costs, effects, and region pressure only. Wiki rate bands may appear as notes, not optimizers.

activity_additions.name: Havenhythe empowered Summoning obelisks (Spirit Plane Connection)
requirements: Havenhythe access via Visions of Havenhythe progression
Reach Shrine of Inanna (south of Wendlewick; fairy ring BKS later access)
Summoning materials for pouch infusion at the currently empowered obelisk
unlocks: Three Shrine of Inanna obelisks; exactly one is empowered at any time for Spirit Plane Connection training
Spirit Plane Connection: gain 2% when infusing a pouch at the empowered obelisk; lose 2% when infusing at a non-empowered obelisk; lose 1% every 20 seconds if no pouches are being infused
Connection effects at empowered obelisks: 23–50% Summoning XP (+3% XP per 10% connection) and 1–10% chance to save materials (+1 percentage point per 10% connection); max 100% connection
Spirit Communion: offer 100 spirit shards to the visiting Spirit Wolf — speeds pouch infusion by 0.6 seconds (4→3 ticks) and stops connection decay from pouch creation for the next 100 infusions
Each pouch infused at any of the three shrine obelisks grants 1 Blessings of the Wolf toward Pikkenflix shop unlocks
Achievements: Dialed In (100% connection), Getting Familiar (offer shards to Spirit Wolf)
Binding contracts do not receive empowered bonuses; Spirit Weaver relic has no effect here
activity_additions.notes: CANONICAL Spirit Plane Connection math row — shrine hub is pointer only and must keep linking this id. Connection state is separate from Amlodd Voice of Seren and from Desert Holy scarab. Do not re-emit shaman outfit equipment here. Buffs clear when leaving vicinity after slow Summoning (26 May 2026 patch).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Havenhythe Summoning production advantage. Not global access to Havenhythe familiars or ingredients.

activity_additions.name: Jackalope familiar (Archaeology soil BoB)
requirements: 30 Summoning
Jackalope pouch: gold charm + 10 spirit shards + empty pouch + jackalope antlers tertiary
Antlers from Havenhythe jackalope hunting (see havenhythe:jackalope-hunting)
unlocks: Non-combat Beast of Burden / forager familiar with 16-minute duration and 40 summoning-point cost
30 inventory slots restricted to Archaeology soil only; stores received soil when space remains
Passive screening: screens stored soil over time with 33% chance to receive materials per soil (uses a sign-of-the-porter charge to bank materials if available); very rare artefact discovery chance
Special Dig for Soil (Jackalope scroll): 12 special-move points (9 with spirit cape) — +10% chance of finding soil while excavating for 1 minute, stackable to 5 minutes maximum
Scroll conversion: 10 scrolls normal / 12 under Amlodd Voice of Seren
activity_additions.notes: CANONICAL jackalope equipment row referenced by shrine hub. Havenhythe owns the antler tertiary; Archaeology utility is global after pouch creation. Not a combat familiar and not an unrestricted BoB. Pair with Moonrise dig-site soil volume.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Havenhythe supplies antlers. Familiar use is global post-pouch; do not require Havenhythe to stay summoned.

activity_additions.name: Jackalope hunting (antler tertiary)
requirements: 32 Hunter
Rabbit snares at jackalope burrows south-west of Shrine of Inanna
Optional: teasing stick to flush one burrow; ferret (Eagles' Peak) to flush multiple burrows
unlocks: Always-drop jackalope antlers (tertiary for jackalope pouch) plus bones and raw rabbit
202 Hunter XP per successful catch (wiki method rates are approximate only — do not hardcode optimizer XP/h)
Starting-region tertiary loop colocated with empowered obelisks and birdhouse plot at the shrine
Trader Woes bank chest northwest of the shrine unlock path for non-drop loot banking
activity_additions.notes: Distinct first-class row from the jackalope familiar. Hunter method only — pouch/BoB effects stay on havenhythe:jackalope-familiar. Not Wilderness black-chin style risk content.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Havenhythe Hunter/Summoning-supply. Eagles' Peak ferret is optional multi-region convenience only.

activity_additions.name: Shrine of the Spirit Wolves (Blessings of the Wolf shop)
requirements: Access to Shrine of Inanna / Pikkenflix
Infuse summoning pouches at any of the three shrine obelisks to earn Blessings of the Wolf (1 per pouch)
5,000 cumulative Blessings required to unlock the entire ordered stock list (comp cape requirement via No Need to Pikkenchoose)
unlocks: Permanent ordered shop unlocks: full shaman's outfit pieces, shaman's headdress add-on, Fang of Mohegan, the Spirit Wolf title
Blessings of the Wolf currency is not spent when unlocking — thresholds gate purchases only (Het's Oasis scarabs-caught pattern)
Pre-Havenhythe owners of shaman outfit + Fang of Mohegan start at 4,200 Blessings without pouch work
Pikkenflix also runs Summoning Supplies at the shrine for local shard/pouch logistics
activity_additions.notes: Shop infrastructure row — do not re-emit havenhythe:shaman-outfit equipment effects here. Prefer this id for Blessings/No Need to Pikkenchoose progression; prefer shaman-outfit for worn XP bonuses.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Havenhythe Summoning shop path. Complements empowered-obelisk production without duplicating connection math.

activity_additions.name: Fang of Mohegan
activity_additions.category: Summoning tele necklace and charm double
requirements: Unlock from Shrine of the Spirit Wolves after accumulating at least 4,200 Blessings of the Wolf (ordered shop unlock)
Visions of Havenhythe for Havenhythe shrine teleport option among daily obelisk destinations
unlocks: Daily teleport to a chosen large Summoning obelisk (Taverley, Gu'Tanoth, Brimhaven, Nature Grotto, Desert, Piscatoris, Well of Voyage, Amlodd, Menaphos Merchant, Havenhythe Shrine of Inanna)
25% chance on kill to activate charm-double on single-charm drops (250 charges total; no recharge; Diango reclaim preserves charges)
Does not stack with Familiarisation triple-charm window; no effect on multi-charm or non-charm NPCs
activity_additions.notes: Re-obtainable via Havenhythe shop after prior SoF/Marketplace history. Equipment row is Havenhythe-gated for ironman reacquire path even though teleports land multi-region.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Havenhythe for modern ironman unlock path. Teleport destinations remain optional multi-region pressure only.

activity_additions.name: Apex hide → Masterwork Ranged craft path
requirements: Havenhythe Big Game Hunter access (high Hunter / Slayer band for apex hides)
100 Crafting to tailor apex hide armour from apex leather
It Should Have Been Called Chinskin: craft a full apex hide set upgraded to +5 (384 apex leather total for full +5 set path)
110 Crafting (and associated multi-skill floors) for masterwork ranged armour after the apex +5 achievement
unlocks: Apex leather / apex sinew self-supply from Havenhythe BGH hides — regional Crafting material not found elsewhere
Tier 85–90 apex hide tank armour via tailoring (non-augmentable, non-degrading); upgrade ladder through +5
Masterwork ranged equipment unlock gate (It Should Have Been Called Chinskin) after full apex +5 set
Masterwork path still consumes multi-region materials (essences, lacquer, glorious bars) — Havenhythe owns the apex leather bottle-neck, not the entire masterwork recipe
activity_additions.notes: Skilling half of BGH. Activity row havenhythe:big-game-hunter stays XP/encounters; this id is the permanent material → armour craft edge for region pickers. Do not invent hide drop tables or XP/h.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Havenhythe for apex hide supply and craft gate. Masterwork finishing materials remain multi-region pressure.
